title: Chrome Border Hover Emphasis
description: Navbar bottom, footer top, and side panel frames should use gray (normal) border by default like navbar toggles, and switch to emphasized border when the cursor is inside the chrome region.
summary: Navbar bottom, footer top, and side panel chrome frames now default to gray (`--border-normal-color`) matching navbar toggle borders. Pointer hover inside `[data-slot="navbar"]`, `[data-slot="footer"]`, or `[data-panel]` transitions the shell edge to emphasized (`--border-emphasized-color`) with a 120ms ease.
